name: Glovis America Vehicle Processing Center - West Point GA

fieldNotes.siteSelection: Roster point (2000 Webb Rd) lands at an open paved parking-lot entrance off Webb Rd at the SW tip of the Kia Georgia (KaGA) / Glovis campus. The Glovis Vehicle Processing Center is the finished-vehicle marshaling/processing operation co-located on the KaGA campus; audited the VPC vehicle-storage yards and rail facility rather than the empty roster pixel. Locked center on the core vehicle lots at 32.9130,-85.1315.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Finished-vehicle Processing Center: no traditional loading docks. Vehicles move by car-carrier truck and rail. dockDoorCount=0 and dockDoors=NONE reflect VPC layout, not a missing count.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - multiple parallel auto-rack rail spurs run directly into the vehicle yards on the NW side (probe rail.png), classic VPC rail receiving/shipping.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - tens of thousands of finished-vehicle stalls in marked rows fill the southern and western lots; this is the dominant feature of the site. Counted as vehicle storage, not box-trailer drop, but dropArea band reflects massive vehicle marshaling capacity.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Medium confidence. The KaGA/Glovis campus is a secured private facility with controlled access; no Street View inside. Internal guard/checkpoint structure visible near campus interior roads (gate2.png). Public-road Street View at Webb Rd shows only an open employee-lot apron. Car-carrier trucks enter through a controlled campus gate - treated as truckGate true / remoteGs not certain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Could not positively confirm a staffed booth at the car-carrier gate from imagery; small internal structures present. Left guardShack false, remoteGs true as best estimate; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - the property is a large campus with the Kia assembly plant building cluster plus separate Glovis VPC processing buildings and rail yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - West Point GA, small town; campus surrounded by forest and farmland with an I-85 interchange nearby.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~385 acres for the audited VPC vehicle-yard perimeter; the full KaGA campus including the assembly plant is far larger (~2000+ acres).
